name: Belmond Hotel Rio Sagrado
positioning: Riverside garden retreat on the Urubamba river in the Sacred Valley, between Cusco and Machu Picchu
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet Sacred Valley base with its own train station to Machu Picchu
Guests who want Andean dining and spa time by the river

facts.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Urubamba river in the Sacred Valley, between Machu Picchu and Cusco.
The hotel has a heated outdoor swimming pool.
The hotel hosts al fresco barbecues at El Jardín.
The hotel is a 70 minute drive from Cusco.
The hotel is a 15 minute drive from Ollantaytambo Train Station.
The hotel is a 5 minute drive from Urubamba Town.
Condé Nast Traveler notes the hotel has no TVs.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private train station to Machu Picchu.
Rooms, suites and villas are terraced into the hillside, with views across the river and garden lawns where alpacas graze freely.
Mayu Willka Spa is on the riverfront and offers wellness programs tailored to each guest.
Weddings at the hotel can include a local shaman who connects the couple with the energy of Mother Earth.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote Sacred Valley location requires transportation planning.
